candidate: In native RX FSM VERIFY_RECCLK_STABLE only, replace gtrxreset_i <= '0' with gtrxreset_i <= not mmcm_lock_reclocked;
native_observation: GTRXRESET deasserted36.060us before shared TX/reference-derived user MMCM rawLOCK rose. Existing qualified flag waits another256SYS200 cycles after synchronized lock.
mechanism: Retain native GTRXRESET until the already-existing qualified shared-userclock lock; then preserve full native50us recovered-clock wait. No added counter, FF, initial assertion, or PMA pulse.
necessary_conditions: Physically prove shared MMCM input/reset independent of RX GTRXRESET; this patch is board-clock-architecture-specific.
Verify native FF next-state equivalence if testing a diagnostic two-LUT ECO.
Check exact routed observer sources, timing/skew/DRC, GT input/parameter invariance, matched INIT-only native versus qualified controls, full flash readbacks and normal17 regression.
A production full source build must be tested before recommending the one-line patch.
limits: Observed sequence is a hypothesis, not proof of a manufacturer rule violation or the analog root cause.
One-line patch may fail if reset must assert after clocks settle, or if a separate analog/calibration condition matters.
No recommendation to apply this to RXOUTCLK-derived userclock designs: could introduce dependency.
Digital simulation passed actual vendor FSM but idealizes PLL/RXRESETDONE and cannot verify analog receiver behavior.
